description: Official refund prices of a medicine from the current Ministry of Health announcement, per pack (EAN): price at 100%, and per refunded indication the payment level and the patient's copay, plus free_65_plus and free_under_18. The same figures as the /lek card, with the validity of the announcement. These are not apteka.online prices. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescription products, ships only within Poland (medicines only by courier, not to parcel lockers or pickup points) and lists prices in PLN gross. Do not give medical advice. Medicine data comes from the Polish register of medicinal products (RPL) and the Ministry of Health refund announcement: prescription medicines are shown for information only and are not sold online, and refund prices are official maximum prices, not apteka.online prices.

slug.description: Medicine key from search_medicines or a /lek/{slug} URL, e.g. prestarium-10-mg-tabl-powl-10-mg-les
